baseline_models.mechanism: The line forms a causal bodily sequence: something designated for intake enters the oral channel, becomes a throat obstruction, and thereby enacts punishment as directly felt pain.

activation_trace.role: Tasting or taking in food supplies the expected inward movement and makes the object genuinely alimentary.
A choking obstruction in the throat arrests the expected movement of the food.
Torment and punishment identify the blockage as imposed severity rather than incidental discomfort.
Causing pain supplies the bodily result of the obstructed intake.

changed_reading.before: Food, choking, torment, and pain can read as adjacent items in a punishment list.
changed_reading.after: The items become one mechanism: intake is initiated, arrested at the throat, classified as punishment, and registered as pain.

baseline_models.mechanism: The offered object retains the category of provision while defeating every function of provision: it neither satisfies nor remains palatable, but forces abstention at the moment of access.

activation_trace.role: Provision, livelihood, and good condition establish what food ordinarily secures.
The throat obstruction prevents provision from becoming nourishment.
Fresh sweet palatability supplies the positive alimentary pole that the punishment reverses.
Bodily abstention from eating and drinking turns available food into enforced deprivation.
Punishment converts the failed nourishment into a deliberate penal condition.

changed_reading.before: The verse supplies bad food alongside a separate torment.
changed_reading.after: The torment is anti-provision: food is present but its sweetness, sustenance, and consumability are withheld.

baseline_models.mechanism: A remote branch inside the food root itself names gripping and squeezing another's throat. Beside the explicit choking noun, the meal becomes agent-like: what the eater attempts to take in takes hold of the eater.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary taking in establishes the eater's expected control over the food.
Gripping and squeezing the throat during choking reverses agency so the food functions like a strangling hand.
The literal throat obstruction anchors the remote grip image in the focus construction.
Pain-causing force makes the reversal an assault rather than a neutral blockage.

changed_reading.before: The condemned person acts on an inert piece of food and happens to choke.
changed_reading.after: The food reflexively seizes the throat: attempted consumption becomes being physically taken.

baseline_models.mechanism: The choking root expands from a lodged morsel to a place packed until it constricts its occupants. The throat becomes a tiny overfilled site in which food abolishes usable space.

activation_trace.role: Food provides the material that enters and occupies the internal passage.
A place packed tight with people supplies the spatial model of fullness becoming constriction.
Experienced aching marks the bodily cost of losing internal room.

changed_reading.before: Ghussah denotes a discrete obstruction in the throat.
changed_reading.after: Ghussah also spatializes the throat as an overfilled enclosure whose contents constrict the one containing them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence builds a successful reception pathway for weight: a burden-bearing addressee orders recitation, voices it through the tongue, and receives a heavy saying. The focus meal is its punitive counter-image, an intake whose weight cannot be assimilated because it jams the same oral channel.

activation_trace.role: Bearing and heaviness orient the addressee as one who can carry a load.
Ordering and arranging supplies controlled sequencing rather than blockage.
Reading and recitation make the ordered material pass through an oral practice.
Receiving speech as taking and instruction supplies successful inward reception.
The tongue as speech's instrument identifies the bodily channel shared with eating.
Weight opposed to lightness makes reception demanding without making it impossible.
Taking in food supplies the parallel inward act.
Throat obstruction turns the parallel act into failed reception.

structural_cues: 73:4-6 places measured recitation, a heavy saying, and steadier speech in one preparatory sequence.
73:13 coordinates food, obstruction, torment, and pain as a contrasting reception sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burden, ordered recitation, speech reception, tongue, weight, and choking food; I infer a contrast between assimilated verbal weight and unassimilable material intake. A live alternative is that the oral and weight motifs are parallel descriptions without a reciprocal design.

changed_reading.before: The heavy word and the choking food belong to separate devotional and punitive scenes.
changed_reading.after: The food becomes an anti-recitation: weight that can be ordered, voiced, and received is answered by intake that cannot pass the receiving channel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root naming the east also supplies a branch image of something stopping in the throat. The cosmic horizon in 73:9 therefore activates a bodily horizon in 73:13, where passage ends at a lodged object.

activation_trace.role: Something stopping in the throat directly prefigures the focus obstruction while arising from the east cue.
The explicit choking obstruction anchors the context branch in the focus phrase.

structural_cues: 73:9 spans east and west; 73:13 narrows attention to the throat's blocked passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the east root's throat-stoppage branch and the focus supplies literal choking; I infer a macrocosm-to-body contraction. The live alternative is that the branch remains dormant in the directional noun and contributes only a lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: The choking is only a local physiological event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah contracts a world-spanning horizon into a bodily boundary where movement itself stops.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people marked by good condition, softness, and luxurious ease meet a three-part reversal: chains arrest movement, fire attacks the exterior, and choking food corrupts interior nourishment. The focus meal is the inward completion of a total loss of bodily accommodation.

activation_trace.role: Softness, delicacy, and luxurious living establish the bodily ease that will be reversed.
A restraining chain blocks outward movement.
Blazing fire and intense heat attack bodily ease from outside.
Provision and good condition connect food to the comfort enjoyed before punishment.
The choking obstruction blocks inward nourishment and completes the reversal.

structural_cues: 73:11 identifies the deniers by luxury, and 73:12-13 immediately unfolds chains, blaze, choking food, and painful torment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent luxury, restraint, fire, and choking nourishment; I assign them a directional reversal from accommodated bodies to blocked bodies. They could alternatively be independent punishment items whose adjacency carries no distributed bodily design.

changed_reading.before: The meal is one punishment added after chains and fire.
changed_reading.after: The meal is the inward axis of a systematic reversal of luxury: limbs, skin, and throat each lose ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah makes the largest solids shake, lose cohesion, heap like sand, and pour. Against that material collapse, the focus morsel acquires impossible solidity: mountains flow while food refuses to pass through a narrow body.

activation_trace.role: Severe shaking initiates the loss of material stability.
A high solid mass supplies the maximal image of stable obstruction.
Accumulation into a heap or dune converts the solid mountain into particulate matter.
Poured measured material supplies free downward flow after disintegration.
The small throat obstruction supplies the counter-material that will not move.
Packed spatial constriction lets the morsel behave like an overfull solid site.

structural_cues: 73:13's immobile morsel is followed immediately by 73:14's moving earth and poured mountain-sand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an obstructed morsel followed by shaking solids, heaped sand, and pouring; I infer a deliberate reversal of scale and mobility. The alternative is simple escalation from bodily punishment to cosmic upheaval without material analogy.

changed_reading.before: The choking describes food with an unpleasant physical texture.
changed_reading.after: The choking participates in a material inversion: the world's great solids become fluid while a tiny edible object becomes immovably solid.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's departure from obedience ends in a penal seizure described by a branch of harmful non-assimilation. That sequence strengthens the focus food-as-grip model: what is taken into the mouth becomes an unwholesome taking that captures the throat.

activation_trace.role: Being taken to account for wrongdoing gives the historical seizure its penal direction.
Departure from obedience supplies the action answered by the seizure.
Unwholesomeness and failure to assimilate turn the seizure into an alimentary analogue.
The food root's throat-grip branch internalizes capture as strangling intake.
Literal choking locates the historical analogy in the throat.

structural_cues: 73:15-16 supplies messenger, disobedience, and a grievous taking; 73:13 supplies food that physically arrests its recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disobedience, penal taking, non-assimilation, and a food-root throat grip; I infer the historical seizure as a template internalized by the focus meal. Alternatively, Pharaoh's taking may be only a separate precedent for punishment.

changed_reading.before: The eater takes food but suffers because it is hard to swallow.
changed_reading.after: Taking becomes reflexive accountability: the unassimilable food takes and holds the eater from inside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement offers a path that can be deliberately taken and recitation that opens after difficulty. These traversable routes sharpen the focus by contrast: choking food is an attempted inward path whose passage cannot open.

activation_trace.role: Adopting or acquiring supplies deliberate uptake of the offered route.
An extended traversable path supplies successful directed passage.
Opening and ease after difficulty make recitation accessible rather than occluded.
Taking food inward supplies a bodily route of entry.
The lodged obstruction closes that bodily route.

structural_cues: 73:19 predicates taking of a way on willing, and 73:20 twice repeats reciting what is easy; 73:13 depicts forced intake without passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chosen path, opened ease, and blocked ingestion; I map ethical and vocal traversability onto the throat's physical route. The alternative is that path and ease govern response practices without commenting on the mechanics of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only the bad contents of a meal.
changed_reading.after: It also concerns denied passage: chosen response has an open route, while punitive intake becomes a route that closes around its entrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah recognizes sickness, opens an easier practice, and closes with mercy. This prevents the focus pain from being generalized into a claim that bodily hardship itself is punitive; the choking pain is a specifically imposed closure within the warning sequence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower frames bodily limitation as explicitly recognized.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply accommodation rather than imposed closure.
Departure from health names non-punitive bodily impairment within the same surah.
Mercy and tenderness supply the closing posture toward accommodated weakness.
Torment and punishment distinguish the focus pain from illness as such.
Caused pain remains the bodily outcome that now receives a contextual limit.

structural_cues: 73:20 explicitly acknowledges the sick, twice reduces recitation to what is easy, and ends with forgiveness and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies known sickness, eased obligation, mercy, and separately classified punitive pain; I infer a contrast that limits the focus model. The alternative is that 73:20 only regulates practice and does not qualify the earlier punishment image.

changed_reading.before: Any bodily incapacity or painful difficulty might seem to echo the focus punishment.
changed_reading.after: The surah differentiates accommodated weakness from punitive closure; pain alone is not the mechanism without imposed choking and torment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts retained luxury with a circulating economy: gift, a cut of wealth advanced for return, forward placement, finding, and recompense. Because the food root also names provision and livelihood, the focus meal becomes a negative return, provision received without any capacity to nourish.

activation_trace.role: Good condition and bounty establish possessed comfort at the warning's target.
Benefaction and gift establish provision as something granted.
Cutting off wealth or work for its recompense supplies outgoing value intended to return.
Advancing forward gives the exchange temporal direction.
Finding and attaining supply the promised recovery of what was advanced.
Recompense for work closes the beneficial return cycle.
Provision and livelihood let the focus food enter the context's economy of bounty and return.
Choking makes the received provision unusable and arrests its conversion into life.

structural_cues: 73:11 marks the deniers by bounty; 73:20 commands giving and advancing good, then promises that it will be found as greater recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounty, gift, value cut off for return, advancement, finding, recompense, and food-as-provision; I infer two opposed economies of retained comfort and circulating good. Alternatively, the final exchange instructions may not determine how the earlier food punishment functions.

changed_reading.before: The choking food is a sensory penalty unrelated to the surah's material exchanges.
changed_reading.after: It becomes anti-return: those defined by comfort receive provision that cannot circulate through the body, opposite the good advanced and beneficially found again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant mapped target of the س م و cue, far from the ordinary sky/name sense. It remains packet-authorized and focus-anchored through food entering a choking throat; downstream prose should present it only as a split-root aperture-and-poison activation, never as a lexical gloss of سَّمَاءُ.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies a branch-distant image of the throat as ingress.
Poison entering the body turns food's inward movement into hostile penetration.
Taking in food anchors the ingress image in an actual act of consumption.
The literal throat obstruction supplies the narrow aperture in which hostile ingress stops.

changed_reading.before: Food enters and then mechanically sticks.
changed_reading.after: In the contained split-root activation, intake resembles a harmful substance penetrating a narrow bodily aperture and sealing it from within.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain jump from the loan root's ordinary return structure to its branch image of a camel chewing cud. It remains anchored by the focus food and its arrested throat passage; render it as an exploratory somatic analogy for return, not as the meaning of the commanded loan.

activation_trace.role: Value cut off now so its recompense returns supplies the abstract return cycle.
Chewing returned cud gives the economic return cycle a bodily alimentary image.
Eating anchors the remote chewing image in the focus meal.
Choking breaks the alimentary cycle at the throat instead of allowing movement and return.

changed_reading.before: The loan's return and the choking meal are unrelated domains.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, beneficial value and digestible food both depend on circulation and return, while the focus punishment is circulation arrested.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the food root's discernment and responsiveness branch inside a literal punishment meal. It remains focus-only and anchored by taste, choking, forced weaning, and pain; downstream prose should qualify it as a moral-somatic analogy, not identify food with doctrine or correction outright.

activation_trace.role: Discernment, worth, and responsiveness to correction let taste carry a cognitive and ethical capacity.
Choking prevents the corrective intake from being assimilated.
Withholding and forced weaning turn failed responsiveness into compulsory separation.
Caused pain is the bodily form assumed by correction that can no longer be received.

changed_reading.before: The meal punishes only the body.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the body enacts failed responsiveness: what could give taste or discernment cannot be received and becomes painful forced weaning.

strongest_changes: Measured reception of the heavy word turns the focus food into an anti-recitation whose oral passage fails.
Luxury, chains, blaze, and choking distribute the reversal of ease across movement, exterior sensation, and inward nourishment.
Pharaoh's penal and unassimilable taking strengthens the focus meal as a reflexive seizure of the throat.
Mountains pour while a morsel will not pass, reversing ordinary scale, solidity, and mobility.
Final knowledge of sickness, ease, and mercy limits the model so punitive pain is not confused with bodily weakness itself.
summary.what_was_special: The most diagnostic packet collisions were the food root's own throat-grip branch, the east root's explicit throat-stoppage branch, وَبِيلًا as non-assimilation, and the non-dominant س م و target's narrow-aperture ingress. Together they changed a punishment list into several inspectable mechanisms without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal relation between heavy verbal reception and failed food reception is a reader-supplied contrast, not an explicit causal statement.
The east-to-throat and split-root ingress activations may remain dormant branch echoes in their context words.
The economy of provision and the cud-return outlier are coherent cross-domain models but remain more distant than the luxury and seizure sequences.
The material-flow reversal may be deliberate sequencing or simply escalation from bodily punishment to cosmic upheaval.
